meta.coordinatesOnSite: KKM pages do not publish latitude/longitude in the HTML. The “Peta Lokasi” column is a Google Maps embed whose URL uses only the `q=` search string (place name + area). To get coordinates you must geocode (e.g. full postal address, or the `googleMapsQuery` string) with a geocoding API.
